## Summary

A clear and concise description of what your pull request changes and why.

## Changes

- Outline the main changes, one bullet per feature/fix.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck + tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` completes successfully
- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the existing project style and structure
- [ ] Public API changes are documented in the README
- [ ] No unrelated changes included

## Related Issues

Closes #

## Notes

Any additional context, screenshots, or alternative approaches considered.
